verdict.rationale: Puzzle only references multi-entity consolidation via a third-party 'Joiin Integration' add-on rather than a native multi-entity/consolidation feature within its own platform. There is no evidence of built-in legal-entity management, intercompany eliminations, or native consolidated financial statements. Missing for 10: native multi-entity account structure, intercompany elimination workflow, and first-party consolidated reporting (currently only via external Joiin integration).
